# The published link (godbolt-compute.hlsl) shows DXC rejecting three
# bounds Clang and FXC accept -- but Clang rejects two of them, and
# that needs separating from an objection to `static const`, which is
# plain C++ and unrelated to this issue. Read the `staticConstScalar`
# row: a compiler that refuses it is not answering this issue's
# question at all.
